company.name: Leverage
company.mission: Build reusable technology systems that discover, launch and operate income-producing projects with strong owner control.
operating_principles: Build reusable infrastructure before duplicating project infrastructure.
Separate company, system and project responsibilities.
Automate research and execution where safe; require approval for consequential external actions.
Never invent financial balances, quotas, revenue or payout confirmations.
Keep new projects reversible until evidence supports continued investment.
